annotations.title: Claude vs ChatGPT and OpenAI Pricing Calculator

description: Compares monthly team seats vs direct API spend across Anthropic Claude (Pro, Max, Team, Claude API) and OpenAI ChatGPT (Go, Plus, Pro, Business, GPT API) with prompt caching and 50% batch discount. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/claude-vs-chatgpt-pricing-calculator.

batch_api.description: Apply 50% async Batch API discount. Default false.

cache_hit_pct.description: Prompt cache hit rate percent. Default 50.

input_tokens.description: Average input tokens per request. Default 4000.

output_tokens.description: Average output tokens per request. Default 800.

requests_per_seat_day.description: Prompts or API calls per user per workday (22 workdays/mo). Default 40.

name: calc_claude_vs_chatgpt_cost
title: Claude vs ChatGPT and OpenAI Pricing Calculator
